instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 91D.1 Minimum wage requirements
figure_or_rule_carried: State hourly wage 7.25 from 2008-01-01, or the federal minimum if greater; first 90 calendar days of employment: at least 6.35/h; tip credit (restaurant, hotel, motel, inn, cabin; more than 30/month in tips) up to 40% of the applicable minimum wage, employee may appeal to DIAL; FLSA 29 USC 213 exemptions apply; enterprises under 300,000 annual gross volume exempt except laundering, construction, hospitals/care/schools and public agencies. No scheduled increase in the Iowa Code 2026 text.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 91A.3 Mode of payment
figure_or_rule_carried: Pay at least monthly, semimonthly or biweekly on regular paydays designated in advance; payday not more than 12 days (excluding Sundays and legal holidays) after the end of the period; written agreement may vary; commissions may be paid as a credit with true-up at intervals of at most 12 months. Payment in US currency or negotiable instrument unless written consent to pay in kind. Direct deposit by employee election; employees hired on/after 2005-07-01 may be required to use direct deposit unless account costs push wages below minimum wage, account fees result, or a CBA prohibits it. Mail on written request (keep the request 2 years after). Overdraft charges from late pay recoverable. Expenses reimbursed in advance or within 30 days of the claim.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 91A.4 Employment suspension or termination - how wages are paid
figure_or_rule_carried: On suspension or termination (no discharge/resignation distinction) all wages earned are due not later than the next regular payday for the period in which earned; commission true-up within 30 days; vacation payable only if due under an agreement or employer policy establishing pro rata accrual, prorated to the fraction of the year worked.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 91A.5 Deductions from wages
figure_or_rule_carried: Deduction only if required/permitted by state or federal law or court order, or with written employee authorization for a lawful purpose benefiting the employee. Prohibited: shared till shortages (except one written manager agreement per establishment, 45 days), dishonoured checks within discretion, breakage/damage/customer default unless willful, lost/stolen property unless assigned equipment acknowledged in writing, gratuities, PPE (other than off-duty clothing/footwear) unless CBA, relocation costs over 20 for 91E.1 employers.

instrument_name: Iowa Individual Income Tax Withholding Formula effective January 1, 2026 (released November 2025)
article_or_section: Steps 1-4, deduction tables 1A/1B, pay periods, examples 1-10
figure_or_rule_carried: T1 = G - D; T2 = T1 x 3.80%; T3 = T2 - W/P; T4 = T3 + A. D per period (2024+ IA W-4): col A Other / MFJ spouse with earned income / missing: annual 13,000 (weekly 250, biweekly 500, semimonthly 541.67, monthly 1,083.33, daily 50); col B Head of Household: annual 19,500 (biweekly 750, monthly 1,625); col C MFJ spouse with no earned income or QSS: annual 26,000 (biweekly 1,000, monthly 2,166.67). 2023-or-earlier IA W-4: Single 13,000 / Married 26,000 annual and W = allowances x 40. P: daily 260, weekly 52, biweekly 26, semimonthly 24, monthly 12, annual 1; other frequencies annualise. Pre-tax retirement and health contributions excluded from taxable wages. Examples carry cents (ex.1 biweekly 2,100 Other W=40: 59.26); the document contains no rounding instruction and no supplemental-wage rule. Tables alternative at the IDR withholding information page.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 422.5 Tax imposed (individual income tax rate)
figure_or_rule_carried: Tax on every resident and nonresident on entire taxable income at three and eight-tenths percent (3.8%); nonresident tax = tax on all income less nonrefundable credits, times the Iowa-source fraction (assessment level). 422.16(2)(e) applies this 422.5 rate to supplemental wages treated separately when federal tax is withheld from them: supplemental rate 3.8%.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 422.16 Withholding of income tax at source (deposit, return and W-2 provisions)
figure_or_rule_carried: Withhold from Iowa residents and nonresidents working in Iowa. Quarterly return due the last day of the month after the quarter. Deposits: quarterly if under 6,000/yr and at most 500/month; monthly if over 500 in any month and at most 5,000 per semimonthly period, due the 15th of the following month (3rd month with the quarterly return); semimonthly if over 5,000 per semimonthly period, 1st-15th due the 25th, 16th-end due the 10th of the next month; annual election for at most 2 employees with written consent, paid with the Q1 return. Income statement (W-2) to the employee by January 31 (terminated employee on request within 30 days of last payment).

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 96.1A Definitions (subsec. 36 taxable wages, as amended by 2025 Acts ch 125 = SF 607)
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wage base = greater of (a) 33 1/3% of the statewide average weekly wage used in the previous calendar year to set maximum weekly benefit amounts, x 52, rounded to the next highest multiple of 100, or (b) the FUTA wage base. Fraction lowered from two-thirds to one-third by SF 607 (2025 Acts ch 125 sec. 1), first applied to CY2026.

instrument_name: IWD press release 2025-06-30 Iowans' unemployment benefits increase starting July 6 (CY2026 taxable wage base)
article_or_section: release text and FY2026 benefit table
figure_or_rule_carried: Average annual wage 2024 = 61,098.90; SF 607 signed 2025-06-05 lowered the fraction from two-thirds to one-third and the maximum rate from 9% to 5.4%; CY2026 taxable wage base 20,400 (CY2025 39,500). Derivation: 61,098.90 / 3 = 20,366.30, next multiple of 100 = 20,400 (matches US-IAP9V-001 and US-IA-002). FY2026 max WBA 622-763 by dependents (53-65% of SAWW) from benefit week 2025-07-06.

instrument_name: IWD announcement 2026-06-30 Iowans' unemployment benefits increase starting July 5 (CY2027 taxable wage base)
article_or_section: release text and FY2027 benefit table
figure_or_rule_carried: CY2027 taxable wage base 21,100 (up from 20,400 in CY2026; 39,500 in CY2025); average annual wage 2025 = 63,213.58. Derivation: 63,213.58 / 3 = 21,071.19, next multiple of 100 = 21,100. FY2027 max WBA 644-790 by dependents from benefit week 2026-07-05. The 2027 rate table is not announced in this release.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 96.7 Employer contributions and reimbursements
article_or_section: 96.7(2)(c) new employers; 96.7 (nonprofit reimbursements not deductible from wages)
figure_or_rule_carried: New non-construction contributory employer pays the rate of the fourth benefit-ratio rank but not less than 1% until its account has been chargeable for 12 consecutive quarters; construction or landscaping new employers per rule (5.4% in 2026 per US-IAP9V-001). Reimbursements by nonprofits may not be deducted from employees' wages. No employee UI contribution provision located in the text read (employee contributions exist only in AK, NJ, PA: US-FED-P5-2-006).

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 252G.3 Centralized employee registry - employer reporting requirements
figure_or_rule_carried: New hire and rehire report to the centralized employee registry within 15 days of hire, or electronic transmissions 12-16 days apart. Fields: employer name, address, FEIN; employee name, address, SSN, date of birth; whether dependent health coverage is available and the date the employee qualifies; address for income withholding orders/garnishment notices. Means: copy of the IA W-4 by mail/fax, approved electronic media, or federal W-4 plus the other items. Multistate electronic reporters may designate one state and notify HHS in writing.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 642.21 Garnishment - exemption from net earnings
figure_or_rule_carried: Disposable earnings exempt to the CCPA extent, plus an annual cap per judgment creditor by expected annual earnings: under 12,000: 250; 12,000-<16,000: 400; 16,000-<24,000: 800; 24,000-<35,000: 1,500; 35,000-<50,000: 2,000; 50,000 or more: 10% of expected earnings. Caps do not apply to support (ch. 252D, 598.22, 598.23, 627.12). Employer may not withhold more than the law provides, may not discharge for garnishment, not liable for unearned amounts or costs. Disposable earnings = after deductions required by law.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 92.7 Child labor - under sixteen hours permitted
figure_or_rule_carried: Under 16: not before 7:00 a.m. or after 9:00 p.m. (11:00 p.m. June 1 to Labor Day); 30-minute break for 5+ hours; at most 8 h/day and 40 h/week; while school is in session at most 6 h/day and 28 h/week outside school hours (2023 Acts ch 92). Minors receive the state minimum wage (no youth rate in 91D.1 beyond the 90-day rate).

instrument_name: Iowa Withholding Tables effective January 1, 2026 - instructions (released November 2025)
figure_or_rule_carried: Tables by pay period (daily, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, annual) and by IA W-4 status (Other incl. MFJ with earning spouse; Head of Household; MFJ with non-earning spouse or QSS); 2023-or-earlier IA W-4: Single -> Other table, Married -> MFJ table, allowances x 40. Step 5: 'The withholding amounts listed in the tables are rounded to the nearest cent.' Non-standard pay periods: annualise, then divide. Together with the formula (US-IAS5-005, examples in cents) this contradicts the 'round result to nearest dollar' wording carried in US-IA-001.

instrument_name: IDR Iowa Withholding Tax Information page (2026 edition)
article_or_section: Who must withhold; IA W-4; supplemental; nonresident; reciprocity; exclusions; filing frequencies; end-of-year
figure_or_rule_carried: Withhold if office/business in Iowa and federal withholding applies to services in Iowa. IA W-4 (44-019) within 15 days of hire; none on file = zero allowances (701 IAC 307.3(3)(a)); keep W-4 4 years. Supplemental: if federal flat rate used, Iowa at 3.8% (701 IAC 307.2(1)(c)); if combined, tables/formula. Agricultural wages follow federal withholding. Nonresidents working in Iowa withheld at the same rate as residents, except IL residents (form 44-016). Interstate rail/air/truck nonresidents not withheld. Domestic workers and clergy generally excluded from Iowa withholding (estimated payments at 1,000+ liability). Nonresident film/TV exemption by application (44-017). Disaster-response out-of-state employees (29C.24) not withheld. Filing frequencies: quarterly < 6,000/yr (< 500/month); monthly 6,000-120,000/yr; semimonthly > 120,000/yr (> 5,000 per semimonthly period); every period filed even if zero; monthly = 2 payments + quarterly return; semimonthly = 6 payments + quarterly return; returns electronic via GovConnectIowa. Withholding credits (260E NJC 1.5%/3%, SJC 1.5%, 260G ACE up to 10%, TJC 3%) on a credit schedule of the quarterly return. W-2 to employees by end of January; e-file W-2/1099 with Iowa withholding by February 15. NRA additional withholding guidance: 15,000 (or 29,200) / pay periods x 3.8%. Exemption thresholds for the IA W-4: 13,500 MFJ/HoH, 9,000 single (under 65); 32,000/24,000 at 65+.

instrument_name: IDR File a W-2 or 1099 page (tax year 2025 filed in 2026)
article_or_section: Who must file table; About W-2 and 1099 filing; bulk filers
figure_or_rule_carried: W-2s and 1099s carrying Iowa withholding must be e-filed through GovConnectIowa by February 15 (TY2025: 2/15/2026); not required if no Iowa withholding. 'VSPs are no longer required to be filed.' Key & Send manual entry or file upload; 'The IDR file format is unique to IDR. Uploading the same file you uploaded to the Social Security Administration will result in a file rejection.' Payroll providers/transmitters register as GovConnectIowa Bulk Filers (up to 4 weeks). 1099-DA and 1042-S not required.

instrument_name: IDR Electronic Reporting of Wage & Tax Statements and Information Returns (software developer specification; tax years 2023-2025 filed during 2026)
figure_or_rule_carried: EFW2-based, ASCII, 512-byte records + CR/LF; no paper, no PDF; zip accepted. RS: taxing entity code (5-9) blanks; unemployment fields (195-242) blanks; state employer account number (248-267) = 9-digit permit or 12-digit (zero-fill 3 zeros); tax type code (308) blank; local wages/tax (309-330) zeros; state control number and supplemental data blanks; state code 19. Iowa-specific RV record: RS count (3-9), Iowa wages (10-24), Iowa tax withheld (25-39), BEN (40-47) zeros, confirmation number (48-57) zeros, blanks 58-512. Permit number required when Iowa tax > 0; hyphens omitted.

instrument_name: IDR Impact of One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act on Employee Withholding
figure_or_rule_carried: Iowa conforms (rolling conformity, starting point federal taxable income) to P.L. 119-21 no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, car-loan interest and the senior enhanced deduction (up to 6,000 at 65+). Level: ASSESSMENT for tips/overtime/car-loan interest: the Iowa Code and rules provide no withholding allowance for them and the 2026 IA W-4 cannot reflect them; payroll withholds on full tips/overtime. Senior deduction may be reflected as an IA W-4 allowance (employee-driven).

instrument_name: IDR IA 1040 Expanded Instructions Intro 4: Conformity with the Internal Revenue Code (instruction year 2025)
figure_or_rule_carried: From tax years beginning 2023 the starting point is federal taxable income, with rolling conformity to the IRC except as specified by Iowa law; listed differences are business items (pre-2021 depreciation, sec. 179, business interest). No wage-exclusion departure (401(k), 125, HSA, transit, group-term life) is listed; withholding pages state Iowa withholding applies to the same wages as federal and excludes employer retirement and health contributions.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 364.3(12) Limitations of powers - city employment ordinances preempted
figure_or_rule_carried: A city shall not adopt, enforce or administer any ordinance on terms or conditions of employment exceeding or conflicting with federal or state law on minimum or living wage, any form of employment leave, hiring practices, employment benefits, scheduling practices or other terms; ordinances adopted before 2017-03-30 void from that date. Result: no local minimum wage and no local paid-sick-leave ordinance in Iowa cities. (County counterpart in ch. 331 not read.)

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 252D.17 Duties of payor of income (income withholding for support)
figure_or_rule_carried: Support withholding order has priority over any garnishment or assignment for any other purpose; payor may deduct a processing fee of no more than 2 per payment in addition to the support amount; support plus fee not above 15 USC 1673(b) limits; payor need not change its payroll cycle; remit to the collection services center (or clerk / other state entity) within 7 business days of the date the obligor is paid; amounts for several obligors may be combined in one payment.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 715C.2 Security breach - notification requirements - remedies
figure_or_rule_carried: Any person owning or licensing computerized personal information (incl. SSN under 715C.1, not re-read here) must notify affected consumers of a breach in the most expeditious manner possible and without unreasonable delay; a processor holding data for another must notify the owner immediately; delay allowed for law enforcement. Applies to payroll data held by employers and payroll providers. No Iowa rule on SSN truncation on pay statements located in the texts read.

instrument_name: Iowa Administrative Code 871 chapter 23 Employer's contribution and charges (IAC 3/4/26)
authority: Iowa Workforce Development (published by Iowa Legislature)
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly contribution and payroll report (Form 65-5300) with quarterly wage detail by SSN, filed electronically; contributions due the last day of the month following the quarter (weekend/holiday: next business day); new employers from the quarter they become liable; late quarters delinquent with 96.14(2) penalty. 23.6: each employer pays on wages up to the taxable wage base; contributions may NOT be deducted from employee pay; 'Only wages reported to the Iowa unemployment insurance program may be used in computing the employee's reportable taxable wages in Iowa' (no credit for wages reported to another state); successor with experience transfer may count predecessor wages. 23.5: tips reported by the employee to the employer are taxable wages. 23.13 interstate reciprocal coverage election for multistate workers; 23.24 localization / base of operations / direction and control tests.

instrument_name: IWD UI Employer Handbook: Employers Covered Under the Law
article_or_section: Determining your liability; excluded services and wages
figure_or_rule_carried: Liability: wages paid in any quarter of the current or preceding year; agricultural: 20,000 gross in a quarter or 10+ workers in 20 weeks; domestic: 1,000 in a quarter; 501(c)(3) may elect reimbursable status; cities, counties, school districts, townships and community colleges reimburse (may elect contributions); corporate officers who perform services are employees. Exclusions: sole proprietor, partners, LLC members paid by ownership share, family employment (parent for child, spouse, child under 18 for parent; not for corporations/LLCs), sick/disability pay under a general plan, students employed by their school, curricular student work, church and religious-order services, ministers.

instrument_name: IWD UI Employer Handbook: Employer Resources (separation notices)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers are asked to 'promptly notify IWD' of a separation through the Separation Notice Alleging Disqualification form in the employer portal, and to answer the Notice of Separation and Wage Request within 10 days of mailing to protest a claim. Framed as a practice for disqualification claims, not as a statutory notice to the employee; no Iowa statute requiring a separation notice to the employee was located in the texts read.

instrument_name: Iowa Code 2026 sec. 91A.2 Wage payment collection - definitions (territorial reach, wages, liquidated damages)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employee = natural person employed IN THIS STATE for wages (incl. commission salespersons); employer = person who in this state employs for wages. Ch. 91A (pay frequency, final pay, deductions, pay statement 91A.6) therefore reaches work performed in Iowa, not Iowa residents working elsewhere. Agricultural family members, owner/tenant-operators and neighbours exchanging labour excluded; independent contractors excluded. Wages include vacation, holiday, sick leave and severance due under an agreement or employer policy. Liquidated damages = 5% x unpaid wages x days late (excluding Sundays, holidays and the first 7 days), capped at the unpaid amount.

instrument_name: House File 2212 (91st General Assembly) - direct care professional minimum wage - introduced text and bill history
figure_or_rule_carried: Would set 20.00/h (19.10 in the first 90 days) for direct care professionals from 2026-07-01. STATUS: NOT ENACTED - introduced 2026-01-29 and referred to House Health and Human Services (H.J. 175); no further action in the bill history read 2026-11-02; only the Introduced version exists. Level: minimum wage (WTC rate floor) - do NOT model. A tier-B search summary stated this rate as in force from 2026-07-01; that is wrong.

instrument_name: 2026 IA W-4 Employee Withholding Allowance Certificate 44-019a (11/13/2025) with CER new-hire form 44-019d
article_or_section: Filing status; exemption; lines 1-8; page 3 CER
figure_or_rule_carried: Filing status Other (incl. single) / Head of Household / MFJ / QSS with 'does your spouse also have earned income?'; EXEMPT entry with year (nonresidents may not claim); military-spouse exemption box with state of domicile; line 2 allowance 40 per dependent; line 8 additional withholding; new W-4 within 10 days when allowances decrease. Page 3 = Centralized Employee Registry reporting form 44-019d (11/18/2024), completed by the employer within 15 days of hire. Same file as US-IA-P5-2-001 (re-read for the DD fields, not re-fetched).
